This was stated by the ex-investigator of the GSU of the IC of the Russian Federation in the Krasnoyarsk Territory and the Republic of Khakassia Fedor Glushkov.

te: What will happen to secondary housing prices by the end of the year? Forecasts of the “WG” experts
de: Prices in the secondary market in the coming months will not change significantly, experts believe - buyers have become less active, but sellers are not ready for discounts.
